The project

DESTRUA (DESTROY) is the last command remembered by a lonely, self-aware robot trapped in a decaying factory. With a corrupted directive and a malfunctioning fourth-dimensional loop device, it tries again and again to destroy its surroundings. Every minute, reality resets and most actions are undone — but the damage remains. Made for a game jam; my first attempt at a conventional game.
